title: Raise logit softcap 15 -> 30
description: One line in GPT.forward: softcap = 15 -> 30; nothing else touched.
reflection: NEGATIVE and clearly so: val_bpb 0.990209 vs baseline 0.986277, i.e. +0.0039, about 4x the ~0.0009 noise floor. The readout is the cleanest of the cell -- FLOPs/token 3.460347e8 (identical), params 71.3M (identical), peak VRAM 32.9GB (identical), MFU 38.77% vs 38.5%, and the softcap-30 run actually saw MORE data (334.0M tokens / 2548 steps vs 331.5M / 2529). So the entire gap is quality per token, with zero compute confound. My mechanism was wrong: I argued the cap taxes confident predictions late in training. It does not appear to; instead softcap=15 is doing real regularisation work, damping overconfident logits and keeping the cross-entropy gradient bounded for the whole run. The important finding is not the loss but the SENSITIVITY: one constant, no compute cost, moved val_bpb by 0.0039 -- larger than depth 10->12 bought (-0.0027) and far larger than anything the capacity axis has produced since. After five rounds where every capacity and batch knob came back flat, the output head is the first live axis in the cell, and the gradient on it points DOWN, not up. The obvious follow-up is softcap 15 -> 10 (or 8), which is the same one-line change in the direction the measurement actually favours; I would spend the next slot there rather than anywhere on capacity.
